snippet.title: Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth ❄️ Teaser Demo announcement! 😱
snippet.description:
We’re excited to share that you can now play the Moomintroll: Winter’s Warmth teaser demo!

Play the demo to get a glimpse of what’s to come! This is just a small peek at Moomintroll’s winter journey ❄

Get the demo here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4179690/Moomintroll_Winters_Warmth_Demo/
